title: Soft Prompts for Evaluation: Measuring Conditional Distance of Capabilities
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focused on measuring the 'conditional distance' of model capabilities in tasks like autoregressive prediction, text repetition, token skipping, reverting fine-tuning, pathfinding, and chess prediction.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the research.
